blinding_guess.why: send_command_long_and_wait treats COMMAND_LONG.confirmation as an ACK-required flag (is_ack_required = (confirmation != 0 || is_ardupilotmega()) && !is_px4(), command.cpp:158) and the arming/set_home/takeoff/land/trigger_control services send confirmation = 1 on the first transmission (command.cpp:320,331,342,355,367); ACK waiting is gated on HEARTBEAT.autopilot so COMMAND_ACK.result from a PX4 FCU is never read and success is reported as ACCEPTED unconditionally (command.cpp:190-193). This looks inconsistent with a confirmation counter whose first transmission is 0.

notes: MAVLink message types appear in code as mavlink::common::msg::COMMAND_LONG / COMMAND_INT / COMMAND_ACK / HEARTBEAT (common dialect), generated from the external mavlink package (build_depend mavlink, mavros/package.xml:26; dependencies.rosinstall points to mavlink-gbp-release release/kinetic/mavlink). Their definitions are MAVLink XML dialect files, not .msg/.srv/.action/.idl, and none is in the snapshot; ros_distro is null, so no dependency definition could be fetched. Hence definition_id is null for every port, and the provided elements msg:mavlink/COMMAND_LONG, msg:mavlink/COMMAND_INT and field:mavlink/COMMAND_LONG.confirmation are in neither declares nor not_declared: the package does use and send them (command.cpp:240-253, 271-286; confirmation set at command.cpp:244 from a const uint8_t confirmation_fixed, which is forced to 0 in broadcast mode at command.cpp:238), but the declaration templates need the definition hash / definition field type, which is unavailable. QoS is null throughout: ROS 1, and these are MAVLink wire messages sent via UAS_FCU(m_uas)->send_message_ignore_drop, not ROS topics. COMMAND_LONG frame is null: the message has no frame field and the code declares none, although param5-7 are commented x_lat/y_lon/z_alt in mavros_msgs/srv/CommandLong.srv:11-13. COMMAND_INT is sent without waiting for COMMAND_ACK (command.cpp:210-219, success always true). No rate is set for any element; sys_status sends the capabilities request COMMAND_LONG from a 1.0 s timer (sys_status.cpp:450), which is a retry schedule rather than a declared rate, so rate_hz is left null. The ROS services wrapping these messages (~cmd/command: mavros_msgs/CommandLong, ~cmd/command_int: mavros_msgs/CommandInt, command.cpp:68-69) are not packet elements and are not listed in declares. Config key cmd/use_comp_id_system_control (default false) selects the target component id (command.cpp:66, 235-237; launch/apm_config.yaml:35, px4_config.yaml:35).
